## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **Tekla 3D BIM Modeling (LOD 400)**: Complete coordinated structural framing models with clash detection, anchor bolt layouts, and accurate profile dimensions.
2. **Fabrication Shop Drawings**: Single-part fittings, column and beam assembly drawings, section views, weld symbols, and part marks.
3. **General Arrangement (GA) Plans**: Erection plans, floor framing layouts, roof framing plans, cross-sections, and holding down bolt layouts.
4. **Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB)**: Industrial warehouse sheds, curved rafters, mezzanines, canopies, and portal frames.
5. **Connection Detailing**: Moment connections, shear connections, splices, base plates, and stiffener plates per AISC/BS standards.
6. **CNC & Data Deliverables**: DSTV, NC files, DXF profiles, and comprehensive Bill of Materials (BOM) summaries.
